{{Stub|summary}} {{Terminology Infobox |title = Reactor Drive |type = Lore }} {{Description|The [[Exostrider]]'s power core and Lahai-Roi's underground "sun."
Royan records say this energy entity was removed from the Exostrider and placed underground to sustain the haven. However, monitoring data confirms a gradual but steady decline in its energy output. Both the Roya and the Spacetrek Collective are now formulating emergency contingencies in response.|Glossary}} The '''Reactor Drive''' is the [[Exostrider]]'s power core which acts as [[Lahai-Roi]]'s underground "sun".Glossary, Reactor Drive :The Exostrider's power core and Lahai-Roi's underground "sun." :Royan records say this energy entity was removed from the Exostrider and placed underground to sustain the haven. However, monitoring data confirms a gradual but steady decline in its energy output. Both the Roya and the Spacetrek Collective are now formulating emergency contingencies in response. The Reactor Drive is the reason Lahai-Roi is the underground haven it is.{{Quest|What Burns Beneath Frostlands}} :'''Ms. Voss:''' Their proliferation has limits. Take the Reactor Drive in the sky, for example. Once it's depleted, it's gone for good. :About the New Solar Ceremony... :'''Ms. Voss:''' The New Solar Ceremony will replace Lahai-Roi's "Sun"—the Exostrider's Drive—with one we built ourselves. :'''Ms. Voss:''' We do have the Exostrider's Drive to thank for this underground haven. But to fight the Threnodian, it must be re-integrated with the Exostrider. :'''Ms. Voss:''' That's why we're building an artificial sun. So the Drive can be restored to the Exostrider's mecha. ==Overview== Monitoring data confirms that there is a gradual but steady decline in the Reactor Drive's energy output, which both the [[Roya Tribe]] and [[Spacetrek Collective]] are formulating emergency contingencies for. According to Ms. Voss, once the Reactor Drive's energy output is depleted, it's gone forever, which is why Lahai-Roi planned the New Solar Ceremony to replace the Reactor Drive with an artificial sun, thus also letting the Exostrider take back the Reactor Drive. ===Hyvatia Detector=== The [[Hyvatia]] Detector is a critical sensor for the Reactor Drive. It's a surface detector built by the Spacetrek Collective at [[Sundermere]] for the Reactor Drive's inspection and maintenance. It's vital for the Ceremony's data calibration.{{Quest|What Burns Beneath Frostlands}} :'''Mornye:''' The Void Storm has corrupted the Hyvatia Detector, a critical sensor for the Reactor Drive. It's off course and now targeting us. :Hy-what-tia? :'''Mornye:''' A surface detector built by the Spacetrek Collective for the Reactor Drive's inspection and maintenance. It's vital for the Ceremony's data calibration.
